'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Northern Aleppo clashes (2024)|2024 Northern Aleppo clashes]]
***[[Anti-Turkish sentiment|Anti-Turkish]] riots occur in [[Turkish occupation of northern Syria|Turkish-occupied Northern Syria]] following [[Anti-Syrian refugee sentiment in Turkey|anti-Syrian]] [[2024 Kayseri Riots|riots]] in [[Kayseri]], [[Turkey]], yesterday. *[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Siege of Khan Yunis]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] order a mass [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] of [[Palestinians]] from the entire eastern half of [[Khan Yunis]] and surrounding areas in anticipation of a new ground assault on the city. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Beryl]] makes landfall on the island of [[Carriacou]], [[Grenada]], as a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|category 4 hurricane]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/07/01/weather/hurricane-beryl-caribbean-landfall-monday/index.html (CNN)]
**Hurricane Beryl intensifies to a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|category 5 hurricane]], becoming the earliest on record in the basin, and kills at least one person on the [[Windward Islands]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/07/01/weather/hurricane-beryl-caribbean-landfall-monday/index.html (CNN)]
*A car driving the wrong way in central [[Seoul]], South Korea, strikes pedestrians waiting at a traffic light, killing nine people and injuring four others. [https://apnews.com/article/south-korea-car-accident-seoul-1357f9065602aa9674b2451fde949e90 (AP)]
*An [[Air Europa]] [[Boeing 787 Dreamliner]] aircraft experiences severe [[turbulence]] while flying from [[Madrid]], Spain, to [[Montevideo]], [[Uruguay]], injuring 40 people and forcing the flight to divert to [[Natal, Brazil]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c51ygv3lwlro (BBC News)]
*At least 89 [[African immigration to Europe|migrants]] are killed after their boat, which carried 170 migrants, capsized off the coast of [[Ndiago, Mauritania|Ndiago]], [[Mauritania]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/07/04/europe/mauritania-migrant-boat-sinking-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Argentina–Bolivia relations]], [[2024 Bolivian coup attempt]]
**[[Bolivia]] summons its [[ambassador]] to [[Argentina]] after [[President of Argentina|Argentine President]] [[Javier Milei]] called the recent [[coup]] attempt "fraudulent" and implied that it was staged. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivia-summons-argentine-ambassador-after-milei-brands-attempted-coup-2024-07-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Blasphemy in Pakistan]]; [[Jaranwala church arsons]]
**A court in [[Sahiwal]], [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] a [[Christianity in Pakistan|Christian]] man [[Capital punishment in Pakistan|to death]] for [[blasphemy]] against [[Islam in Pakistan|Muslims]] on [[social media]] after [[anti-Christian]] mobs [[arson|burned down]] dozens of homes and [[church (building)|churches]] in [[Jaranwala]], Punjab, in August 2023. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-blasphemy-christian-death-sentence-mob-9fbaf36d5c78659d58a414f7f048ce8a (AP)]
*[[Trump v. United States|''Trump v. United States'' (2024)]]
**In a landmark ruling, the [[Supreme Court of the United States]] rules 6–3 that presidents have presumed [[absolute immunity]] from criminal [[prosecution]] for official acts taken in exercising constitutional powers while serving as president, and have no immunity for "unofficial acts". [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-immunity-supreme-court-decision-07-01-24/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Mexican authorities discover the bodies of nineteen men who were shot dead in and near a [[dump truck]] abandoned in [[La Concordia, Chiapas]], near the [[Guatemala–Mexico border|Guatemalan border]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-chiapas-20-killed-drug-cartels-0ca11d7b79b266a6520fd9f98af390ba (AP)]
*Ukrainian officials uncover a plan to storm [[Verkhovna Rada|parliament]] and seize control from the [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy#Presidency|current government]] on [[Constitution Day (Ukraine)|Constitution Day]], and arrest four individuals implicated in the plot. [https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-updates-government-overthrow-plot-foiled-sbu/live-69529436 (DW)] 
*A [[mass shooting]] in [[Cincinnati]], [[Ohio]], United States, kills three people and injures two others. An adult suspect has been arrested. [https://www.gunviolencearchive.org/incident/2955139 (GVA)]
*A [[Nepal]]i court sentences [[Ram Bahadur Bomjon]], a man who thousands believed was a [[Rebirth (Buddhism)|reincarnation]] of [[The Buddha]], to 10 years in jail for [[child sexual abuse]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/07/02/asia/nepal-buddha-boy-sentenced-prison-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The Australian Government increases the [[Travel visa|visa]] fee for [[International students in Australia|international students]] from [[Australian dollar|A$]]710 (US$473) to A$1,600 (US$1,068) in an attempt to reduce record levels of [[Immigration to Australia|migration]] that have increased pressure on the Australian housing market. [https://www.reuters.com/world/australia-doubles-foreign-student-visa-fee-migration-crackdown-2024-07-01 (Reuters)]
*[[Sam Mostyn]] is sworn in as the 28th [[Governor-General of Australia]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2024-07-01/sam-mostyn-sworn-in-as-governor-general/104045002 (ABC News Australia)]
*South African President [[Cyril Ramaphosa]] unveils [[Third cabinet of Cyril Ramaphosa|his cabinet]] made up of seven parties. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-coalition-government-explain-aecc75f6a6e79d962c0f92724e1a0b06 (AP)]
